project.description:
# LCP Inbound Demand Engine

Agent-driven inbound demand system for **latestcrazeproductions.com**.

## Source of truth

- **Execution status** → Linear issues (this project)
- **Plan structure** → `scripts/linear-build-plan.json`
- **Documentation** → `docs/*.md` (auto-synced as Linear documents)
- **Narrative** → `docs/BUILD_PLAN.md`

## Current state

| Layer | Status |
|-------|--------|
| Next.js site (~29 routes), CMS, geo page | **Live** |
| SEO matrix | **Live** |
| Registry, orchestrator, agents, cron | **Built — enable after Phase 0** |

## Locked decisions

- Cursor **cloud** SDK, PR-only publish gate
- **7 agents**: Research, Planner, National, Geo, ServiceRefresh, Authority, QA
- Free intel stack (GSC primary) — no Semrush v1
- Content mix: 55/15/15/15
- Max **5 tasks per run**

## Sync

```bash
npm run sync:linear
```

Re-run after editing `docs/` or `scripts/linear-build-plan.json`.
